{{Quote|I nearly smacked into Mosor's Maze while trying to escape the local wildlife on my speeder.|translated=1|Translated account from Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam's Explorer's Log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />}}
'''Mosor's Maze''' was a structure constructed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The maze had two entrances, and many dead ends. Located north of the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars]] [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] in the [[Lowland Basin/Legends|Lowland Basin]], the maze shared similarities with the [[Great Maze of Lok|Great Maze of]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], except that it was much smaller, and lacked a central oasis. According to rumor, when a [[Gender/Legends|man]] by the name of [[Mosor]] discovered his wife with his best [[Officer/Legends|officer]], he constructed the maze as as sort of murderous tomb. In enacting his revenge, Mosor was said to have [[Spice/Legends|drugged]] his wife and her lover, entrapped them in the maze, and left them to [[Death/Legends|die]] exposed to the elements. An [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] by the name of [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] later traveled to the maze during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. An avid [[Historian/Legends|historian]], Tinrilo documented the unusual story about the maze in his [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam's Explorer's Log|Explorer's Log]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I remember playing here as a kid, getting lost for hours. To rekindle the memories (history in of itself!), I decided to test it out myself. Unlike my childhood, I was able to get out of the maze easily. Ah, the memories&hellip;|translated=1|Translated account from Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam's Explorer's Log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />}}
Mosor's Maze was situated north of the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars]] [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] in the [[Lowland Basin/Legends|Lowland Basin]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The maze was constructed out of a [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]] material, and included two entrances marked with archways. By entering one archway, it was possible to follow a correct path through the maze to reach the other; however, many dead ends were spread throughout the maze. The maze was complemented by a third archway, but it was left sealed off. The maze shared similarities with the [[Great Maze of Lok|Great Maze of]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], except that it was much smaller, and lacked a central oasis.<ref name="AED" />

==History==
{{Quote|Rumor tells us the story behind such a design of the imagination, although not a happy story at best.|translated=1|Translated account from Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam's Explorer's Log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />}}
Mosor's Maze was constructed many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref><ref name="SWGDate2">According to the "Explorer's Log (1/8)" data storage unit obtained from ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam|Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam]] was only a child when [[Gender/Legends|he]] first ventured into the maze. In the same item, Tinrilo described himself as "old in age." As the events of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' took place after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it can therefore be deduced that construction of the maze occurred many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> According to rumor, the maze's [[Architect/Legends|architect]] was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Mosor]], who built the maze as a monument to his promise of revenge. As the story went, Mosor came home from a war and found his wife with his best [[Officer/Legends|officer]], named [[Polen]], who had previously been dismissed due to an alleged accident. Enraged, Mosor had the maze built, and on the night of its completion, [[Spice/Legends|drugged]] his wife and her lover on [[Vasarian brandy]], dragging them to the maze in the whispering darkness of the night. He sealed them in thereafter, leaving them to [[Death/Legends|die]] in the [[Temperature/Legends|heat]] of Tatooine's merciless gaze. The walls of the maze had since been brought down, but no corpses were found. This fueled speculation regarding whether the rumors of Mosor's elaborate revenge were true, or if it was simply an unhappy tale told by mothers to scare children away from [[Scout/Legends|exploring]] the maze.<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />

One child, a boy named [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]], was not deterred by such tales. As a kid, Tinrilo played in the maze, getting lost in it for [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Many years later, Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam, by then an old man and a self-proclaimed "Explorer Extraordinaire," returned to Tatooine to pursue his true passion, [[Scholar/Legends|history]]. In keeping with this pursuit, Tinrilo maintained a [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam's Explorer's Log|log]] documenting his travels, which included oft forgotten pieces of historical minutiae. One of these historical locales was Mosor's Maze, which he nearly smacked into by happenstance while trying to escape the local [[Species/Legends|wildlife]] on his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], fickle and dangerous [[bocatt]]s included. He was able to duck into the mouth of the maze and hide while the bocatts passed him by. Luckily for Tinrilo, the trusty maze had been there when he needed it. In his log, Tinrilo recalled his childhood memories of playing in the maze as a kid, and recounted the dark, lurid rumors of its construction. To further rekindle his memory, Tinrilo tested the maze, but unlike in his childhood, he was able to find his way out of the maze easily.<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mosor's Maze was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The maze was one of many unmarked points of interests on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] Tatooine.<ref name="AED" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]] in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] from destroyed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (1/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the maze.<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />
